name: Wakutsu Tomo
source:
Position of the mark: Behind his right arm
Curse: Forbidden to let other people know the real gender
Gift: None

Tomo has been reared as a girl ever since infancy as part of his curse. He carries out his mother's last will i.e. to go on living as a girl keeping his real gender to utmost secrecy. This makes him exercise extreme caution and employ countermeasures ranging from deadly martial arts down to simple skipping PE classes. He knows for real the horror of triggering his curse from a near-death situation he once personally experienced before. So when fate gathered him and other people who share the same curse together, he proposed to form an alliance.
